_doc: Online 1v1 (a Duel with one creature a side): best of three rounds, like Versus offline. Same keys as duel.json, plus rounds_to_win, round_over_ticks (the pause after a round before the next starts) and max_rounds (after that many, the side with more rounds wins, else a draw). Times are in ticks (60 per second) unless named _seconds.
